summary: Phase 13 (Theorem 4.1, modal and structural cases) dispatch. Discharged all nine of the phase's own target constructors as fully-proven per-case lemmas: nested_sound_boxL/_boxR/_diaL/_diaR/_tR/_tL/_fourR/_fourL/_bStruct. boxL's anticipated 'case-split' (flagged by Phase 11's docstring as a possible obstruction similar to id/orL) did NOT manifest: it closes directly via Lemma 4.5 (InputCtx.fillLhs_fm_antitone) composed with Lemma 4.7(iv)'s cs5DerivBoxDiaDistrib, already landed for Lemma 4.8 -- no case-split, no new axiom, no diamond ever appears. fourL/bStruct needed one extra fourBox/bBox lift first (two new small combinators, cs5DerivFourBoxDiaDistrib/cs5DerivBStructDistrib). diaR/fourR needed a genuinely new kdia-flavoured fillRhs-vs-fillFull bridge (analogous to Phase 12's tBox-flavoured impR bridge); the bridge's inner recursive helper had to be indexed by an explicit head/tail pair (Gamma2, rest) rather than a bare list, since the bare-list l=[] case is genuinely FALSE for this bridge direction (confirmed via direct semantic counterexample reasoning) -- a first draft hit this and was corrected before committing. fourR additionally composes one fourDia step to descend from double-diamond to single-diamond. Assembled the top-level nested_sound as a structurally-recursive function over all 19 NestedProof constructors (mirroring NestedProof.height's own recursion shape), plus the nested_sound_provable corollary (NestedProof (empty,A degree) -> Derivable CS5ModalAxiom A). impL was NOT in Phase 13's own task list (Phase 11 already deferred it alongside cut) and is landed as a single, tightly-scoped, documented strategic sorry in its own top-level lemma (nested_sound_impL), isolated from the other 18 fully-proven cases. Also added a missing `public import ...Nested.Rules` to Soundness.lean (needed for NestedProof itself; Phases 11/12 never required it). Verified: lean_verify on nested_sound reports exactly {propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} -- the sorryAx is the one documented impL hole, no other new axiom. Full CI green: lake build 3259/3259, lake test 9253/9253 (exit 0), lake lint (one pre-existing, out-of-territory error in Temporal/Tableau/Saturation.lean), lake exe checkInitImports (exit 0), lake exe lint-style (clean), lake exe mk_all --module (no update necessary), scoped lake shake (only the known Cslib.Init false positive). Axiom count unchanged at 26.
decisions_made: boxL closes via lemma4_5 + cs5DerivBoxDiaDistrib A Delta.fm directly, no case-split -- the anticipated obstruction from Phase 11's docstring did not materialize.

fourL/bStruct each need one extra fourBox/bBox lift (cs5DerivAndCongrLeft, a new left-conjunct congruence combinator mirroring the existing cs5DerivAndCongrRight) before the same cs5DerivBoxDiaDistrib pattern applies; landed as cs5DerivFourBoxDiaDistrib/cs5DerivBStructDistrib.

diaR/fourR's fillRhs-vs-fillFull bridge is kdia-flavoured (not tBox-flavoured like impR): the new schema cs5DerivKdiaUncurrySwapSchema (Gamma Delta A : Proposition) : (Gamma imp box(Delta imp A)) imp ((dia Delta and Gamma) imp dia A), built via deductionTheorem discharge, is the singleton-ctx case; the general-ctx case routes through a NEW inner recursive helper indexed by an explicit (Gamma2 : NestedLhs, rest : List NestedLhs) pair -- never a bare l : List, because the bare-list empty case is mathematically false for this bridge (unlike impR's tBox-flavoured bridge, whose analogous base case genuinely holds).

fourR reuses the same schema instantiated with A := diamond A_target, then composes one extra cs5DerivImpCongrRight _ (fourDia A_target) step at every level to descend from double-diamond to single-diamond.

impL is landed as its own top-level lemma (nested_sound_impL) with a documented sorry, not an inline sorry inside nested_sound's match arm -- keeps the hole isolated and independently trackable, matching this file's per-constructor-lemma convention.
Soundness.lean now imports Nested.Rules directly (previously only Nested.Translation) since nested_sound needs the NestedProof inductive type itself.
dead_ends: A first draft of the diaR/fourR bridge helper was indexed by a bare l : List (NestedLhs Atom) with three match arms ([], [Gamma], Gamma::(Gamma2::rest)), mirroring buildFullChain_imp_buildRhsChain's own shape literally. The l=[] arm required proving box(Delta.fm imp A) imp box(dia Delta.fm imp A), which is NOT a K-valid schema (necessitation cannot distribute an assumed, not closed, antecedent implication this way; confirmed via direct possible-worlds counterexample reasoning during this dispatch). Corrected by re-indexing the helper as an explicit head/tail pair (Gamma2, rest), which never needs an empty-list case at all, since a nonempty list is baked into the parameter shape.
